wave: IND-1 (India source feasibility - acquisition); merged with IND-6a/IND-6b group A+B (full 10-issuer corpus, IND-6c)
policy: All files listed are real, unmodified documents exactly as served by the cited official source (exchange archive or company IR site). Nothing was invented, rounded, or synthesized. No anti-bot protection was bypassed: where a source rejected plain httpx clients, files were fetched through a normal interactive browser session (no captchas solved, no credentials, no cookie forging, no aggregator scraping). SPEC 2.4 (no Screener/Trendlyne/Moneycontrol) and SPEC 27 (source feasibility first) observed.

fetch_session.fetch_user_agent_httpx: Quarterline build (source feasibility research) contact: quarterline-research@proton.me

fetch_methods_used.httpx: plain httpx GET; rejected (403 Akamai or connection drop) by every India source tried
fetch_methods_used.browser: real Chromium session (Playwright); page-context fetch + file save; byte-exact (sha256 verified after transfer)

fetch_session.rate_limiting: single-shot, low-volume fetches (about 30 requests over about one hour); no throttling responses encountered; no rate-limit headers observed
fetch_session.taxonomy_note: CORPUS-WIDE (IND-6c, 20 consolidated instances): the header-comment taxonomy version varies per filing generation — every April/May-filed Q4+FY26 consolidated ORIGINAL carries 'IFIndAs V2.0 (06-02-2026)' and every July-filed Q1 FY27 consolidated instance carries 'IFIndAs V2.1 (26-06-2026)', EXCEPT the Asian Paints Q4 consolidated REVISION (re-filed 15-Jul-2026 under V2.1) whose superseded original is V2.0 — i.e. the version varies within one issuer-period across a revision pair; L&T's Q4 STANDALONE revisions (re-filed within days, 06/07-May-2026) still carry V2.0 (version tracks the filing generation date, not the revision event). Per-instance LevelOfRounding also varies BY ISSUER, not by period: MARUTI and SUNPHARMA declare 'Millions', the other eight declare 'Crores' (presentation metadata only; values are full rupees in all instances). decimals varies -5/-6/-7 (precision, not scale). Namespace http://www.sebi.gov.in/xbrl/2026-01-31/in-capmkt, schemaRef in-capmkt-ent-2026-01-31.xsd (relative; schema not bundled). Original IND-1 note: every instance acquired in IND-1 carried V2.1; superseded by this corpus-wide statement.
fetch_session.taxonomy_note_ind1: Every NSE Integrated Filing (Finance) XBRL instance carries the comment 'IFIndAs V2.1 (26-06-2026)' and uses the SEBI in-capmkt Integrated Finance Ind AS namespace http://www.sebi.gov.in/xbrl/2026-01-31/in-capmkt with schemaRef in-capmkt-ent-2026-01-31.xsd (relative reference; schema not bundled with the instance).
